clarifications.bias_addition_rounding: The bias operand has zero oracle/candidate perturbation, but each separately evaluated fl(sigmoid(logit)+bias) addition has a nonzero rounding guard.
clarifications.ordered_selected_stability: Normative rank-ordered top-8 bytes require all seven adjacent selected-pair proofs in addition to all 1984 selected/unselected membership proofs.

bias.candidate_and_oracle_operand: same exactly decoded f32 bytes materialized identically as binary64

final_addition_rounding.rationale: Each of oracle-i, candidate-i, oracle-j, and candidate-j performs a distinct correctly rounded binary64 addition. One full ULP per addition conservatively exceeds the half-ULP round-to-nearest error, including cancellation and subnormal results.

rmsnorm_decomposition.lambda: shared scalar reciprocal-RMS perturbation, outward bounded before candidate execution
rmsnorm_decomposition.residual: componentwise non-radial input propagation plus f32 materialization/rounding

pairwise_bound.derivative_intervals: for each row k, enclose all perturbed logits and derive [min sigmoid', max sigmoid'] on that interval
pairwise_bound.non_radial: sum_m R_m*max_{a in D_i,b in D_j}|a*w_i[m]-b*w_j[m]|
pairwise_bound.final_addition_rounding: explicit four-addition outward guard defined above
pairwise_bound.bound_accumulation_rounding: candidate-v2 aggregate outward-rounded binary64 calculation guard, unchanged except for the separately added final-addition term
pairwise_bound.fallback: the v1 independent-score sum when any pairwise antecedent is absent

sigmoid_interval_rule.entirely_positive: maximum derivative is at the endpoint closest to zero
sigmoid_interval_rule.entirely_negative: maximum derivative is at the endpoint closest to zero
sigmoid_interval_rule.interval_construction: logit error endpoints and derivative extrema are rounded outward

exact_top8_theorem.membership: for every oracle-selected i and every oracle-unselected j, oracle_score_i-oracle_score_j > B_pair(i,j)
exact_top8_theorem.ordered_selected: for every adjacent pair (s_k,s_{k+1}) in normative oracle rank order, oracle_score_s_k-oracle_score_s_k+1 > B_pair(s_k,s_k+1)
exact_top8_theorem.transitivity: Preserving every strict adjacent relation preserves the complete selected chain; any non-adjacent inversion would require at least one adjacent crossing.
exact_top8_theorem.tie_semantics: descending score; exact ties use lower expert ID, but a zero-margin tie does not satisfy the strict perturbation proof

classification.MATHEMATICALLY_STABLE: minimum of all 1991 required pairwise safety factors is strictly greater than 1 under outward rounding
classification.ENGINEERING_HEADROOM: minimum of all 1991 required pairwise safety factors is at least 2
classification.headroom_rationale: H=2 reserves one additional complete modeled error envelope for implementation/library drift. It is an engineering policy, not mathematically necessary for swap prevention.

guards.signed_zero: canonical binary64 serialization; no comparison-order distinction
guards.outward_rounding: every positive bound accumulation rounds toward +infinity
required_analytical_retention: oracle pre-sigmoid logits, probabilities, bias, and post-bias scores
ordered selected and all unselected IDs
router rows and row-pair antecedent identities
minimum mathematical and engineering safety pairs and factors
